boundary: Governance-weakening inputs are owned here. Anything not enumerated is forbidden.

ci_mode_skips.note: Registered exception: non-interactive CI cannot answer the cost gate. Every skip emits a gate_decision{decision: skipped_by_policy} with reason + decided_by. No other gate in any template may carry a ci_mode skip.

skip_validation.note: No checked-in pipeline may set skip_validation:true. Runtime use must be logged as a gate decision with reason + decided_by.

memoization_enabled_false.note: Disabling the cache is safe direction; enabling-stale-cache concerns belong to cache freshness rules. Logged for audit.

force_warm_start.note: Overrides snapshot content-hash mismatch. Logged with reason + decided_by; theoverride decision should reference the divergence warning.

restore_from_snapshot.note: Logged with snapshot_id + decided_by. Snapshot payloads are trusted only with matching content_hash unless force_warm_start is separately logged.

resume_from_phase.note: Logged with phase + checkpoint id. Skipped phases keep their prior gate decisions; subject changes invalidate them per SHA-binding rules.
